name: Grimin: A New Joke
source:
Enter the world of Grimin, a place where instead of laughing, people need to eat to survive, but if you are happy for too long, you die.

Follow Roger Thahtsur, an eager and hopeful young man who hopes to one day be a stand-up comedian in Murphy, the grandest city in Grimin. On his search for fame, Roger will run into interesting people. Some of whom have good intentions and some who aim to rule with violence, not respect. Make the right choices to uncover the secrets lurking under the surface of Murphy and resist against the ever-approaching force of evil.

[From [url=https://greyt.itch.io/grimin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到格里明的世界。在这里，人们必须进食才能活下去，但如果快乐太久，也会丧命。

跟随热情又满怀希望的年轻人罗杰·塔特瑟，看看他如何努力成为格里明最大城市墨菲的单口喜剧演员。在追寻名声的途中，罗杰会遇到形形色色的人：有些人心怀善意，有些人则妄图用暴力而非尊重来统治一切。作出正确选择，揭开墨菲表面下潜藏的秘密，抵抗步步逼近的邪恶势力。[引自[url=https://greyt.itch.io/grimin]Itch.io[/url]]
